derived.method: Read timestamped aggregate __eligibility only; compare adjacent samples within one process; absent sparse counters assumed zero only for deltas and disclosed, preserved blank in CSV. For each nudges increment, match first credentialResumes increase over preceding baseline at or after start and within 120 seconds. Reset matching on non-JSON lines/process changes; flag gaps >16 seconds, missing counters, multiple increments and incomplete windows. Nominal 15-second sampling uncertainty; no exclusive-causality claim; no identifiers retained.
